is_fraud_case.description: True ONLY if the source reports a specific NZ criminal or regulatory enforcement matter in fraud, bribery, corruption, money laundering, cartel conduct, or markets/insider-trading offending — charges laid, a court appearance, a conviction/guilty plea, sentencing, or an appeal outcome. False for policy announcements, compliance reminders, warnings, statistics, consultations, or civil-only matters. When false, the other fields may be empty.

case_stage.description: The lifecycle stage this source reports. 'convicted' covers guilty pleas/findings before sentencing; 'acquitted' when the defendant was found not guilty; 'sentenced' when a sentence is imposed; 'appeal_outcome' for appeal decisions; 'other' when unclear.

case_name_hint.description: A short neutral description of the matter for matching (e.g. 'wage subsidy fraud, Auckland construction company'). Never invent details.

persons.description: Each specific person the source names as a defendant/accused (NOT investigators, officials, or spokespeople).

name_as_written.description: The person's name exactly as written. Do not normalise or correct. Empty string entries are not allowed — omit unnamed persons.

profession.description: Their occupation/role as stated (e.g. 'company director', 'accountant'). Empty if not stated.

charges.description: The charges against this person as described, verbatim where possible. Empty if not stated.

outcome.description: This person's outcome if stated (e.g. 'pleaded guilty', 'sentenced to 3 years', 'acquitted'). Empty if not stated.

organisations.description: Companies/entities involved in the matter (vehicles, victims, employers). NOT the prosecuting agency.

prosecuting_agency.description: The agency bringing the prosecution as stated (e.g. 'Serious Fraud Office', 'Inland Revenue', 'Commerce Commission'). Empty if not stated.

court.description: The court named (e.g. 'Auckland District Court'). Empty if not stated.

court_identifiers.description: Any court file numbers or citations the source states, EXACTLY as written: CRI numbers (e.g. 'CRI-2024-004-1234'), appeal registry numbers (e.g. 'CA123/2025', 'SC 45/2025'), or neutral citations (e.g. '[2025] NZHC 123'). Never invent or reconstruct one.

region.description: The NZ locality/region of the offending or court as stated. Empty if not stated.

typology_hint.description: The kind of offending in the source's words (e.g. 'tax evasion', 'wage subsidy fraud', 'bribery of an official'). Empty if unclear.

typology_slug.description: The PRIMARY offending typology, classified onto this fixed list. Use "" only when nothing fits. This is your classification; typology_hint stays the source's own words.

agency_slug.description: The prosecuting agency from this fixed list, ONLY when the source states which agency investigated or prosecuted. "" when not stated — never derive it from the offence type.

total_amount_nzd.description: The total sum involved in NZD if the source states one (use the case total, not per-person amounts). Omit or 0 if not stated.

amount_basis.description: Whether the stated amount is alleged (pre-verdict), proven, or a reparations order. Empty if no amount.

start.description: When the offending began, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD / YYYY-MM / YYYY) if stated. Empty otherwise.

end.description: When the offending ended, ISO 8601 if stated. Empty otherwise.

event_date.description: The date of the reported event (charges/conviction/sentencing/appeal), ISO 8601 if stated. Empty otherwise.

name_suppression_mentioned.description: True if the source mentions name suppression, interim suppression, a suppression order, that a person cannot be named, or redaction markers.

suppression_detail.description: The verbatim phrase indicating suppression, if any. Empty otherwise.

covid_related.description: True if the offending involves COVID-19 support schemes (wage subsidy, resurgence payments, CSSP).

exact_excerpt.description: The verbatim sentence(s) from the source this extraction is grounded on. Quote directly; do not paraphrase.

confidence.description: Your confidence (0..1) that this is a genuine fraud/corruption enforcement matter correctly extracted.
